name: application-data-table
title: Data Table
description: Sortable, paginated data table with status badges and row actions, driven by typed columns/rows/status prop contracts.
useWhen: An admin panel or dashboard needs a full data listing with sortable columns, status, and row-level actions.
Users need to scan, sort, or act on many records without leaving the page.
You want a single reusable table primitive instead of hand-editing markup for each dataset.
avoidWhen: The data is small and static — use the simpler application-tables component instead.
Rows need inline editing or drag-to-reorder — build a dedicated grid component for that.
You need client-side virtualization for very large datasets — pair this with a virtualization library.
responsiveBehavior: The table scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports via the wrapping overflow-x-auto container; the outer card and pagination footer remain fixed.
accessibility: Sortable column headers are real buttons with aria-sort reflecting the current sort state.
Status badges pair a color dot with a visible text label, never color alone.
Row action buttons carry a descriptive aria-label identifying which row they act on.

variants.title: Data Table
variants.description: Sortable table with a status column, per-row overflow-menu action, and a pagination footer.
accessibility: The actively sorted column header sets aria-sort so screen readers announce the current order.

variants.title: Data Table (Dark)
variants.description: Sortable table adapted for dark dashboard surfaces with the same status and row-action structure.
accessibility: Header text, row text, and status badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
